response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS n FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS sh FROM c), a AS (SELECT hand, n, sh, AVG(sh) OVER () AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE sh > av

assumptions.assumption: NULL, empty and whitespace-only throws values are merged into a single 'blank/missing' group.
The 'average share across hands' is the unweighted mean of the per-hand shares, taken over all hands including the blank group and before filtering. This equals 1 divided by the number of hands.
Each player is counted once per hand group. Each player_id is assumed to have one throws value in player.
